name: Banyan Tree Macau
desc: Banyan Tree Macau is the city's first high-rise urban resort to showcase the ultimate privilege of private indoor relaxation pools in every suite and swimming pools with serene gardens in every villa. It is part of Galaxy Macau and comprises 256 keys, inc luding 10 expansive villas and the ultra-exclusive Presidential Suite.
address: Avenida Marginal Flor de Lotus, Cotai, Macau, China

name: Raffles at Galaxy Macau
desc: Raffles at Galaxy Macau, featuring approximately 450 suites, introduce a new level of sophistication and refinement to Macau. The design of each suite draws inspiration from a modern palazzo. The famed Raffles butlers, renowned for their thoughtful and discre et service, personally deliver a level of enlightened hospitality that is both gracious and intuitive for every guest.
address: Galaxy Macau Estrada Da Baia, Da Nossa Senhora, Da Esperance  Cotai

name: Sofitel Macau at Ponte 16
desc: Sofitel Macau at Ponte 16 sits on Macau's scenic waterfront in the heart of the historic city center. The hotel offers elegant rooms, suites and villas, diverse restaurants and bars, heated pools, a spa, and a fitness center. Ideal for both business and leisure, it also features versatile meeting and event venues. With Macau International Airport and ferry terminals just 15 minutes away, guests enjoy seamless access…
address: Rua do Visconde Paco de Arcos
